articles.title: Air Taxi Pilot Program Takes Off at Fort Worth Alliance Airport
articles.summary: Texas just became the sixth state to test electric air taxis under a federal pilot program, with the first flights taking off last week at Fort Worth Alliance Airport. The goal? Launch air taxi service in Dallas-Fort Worth and elsewhere in Texas in 2029.…

articles.title: CoPoint AI Acquires Strategy for AI, Adding Founder Brad Bush as VP
articles.summary: Reflecting the rise of AI, two Dallas-based consulting firms that specialize in AI business products and services recently combined. CoPoint AI acquired the client engagements of Strategy for AI. The companies did not disclose the financial terms. In tandem with the deal, Strategy for AI founder and CEO Brad Bush will join CoPoint AI as vice president effective Sept.…

articles.title: SMU Gets $19.3M from DOE to Adapt Oil-and-Gas Tech for Critical Minerals Mining
articles.summary: Southern Methodist University researcher Saeed Salehi will lead a $25 million project to develop a novel concept in critical-mineral mining. The U.S. Department of Energy is backing the project with $19.3 million. Researchers believe the project will create the world’s first synthetic mine embedded within an advanced oil-and-gas drilling and sensing test facility.…
